title: WordPress Developer Intern
description:
Job Tittle: WordPress Developer Intern

Company: Zooye Info Technologies

Location: Nambiyur, Erode, Tamil Nadu

The intern works on live websites, themes, and plugins to support client or company web projects. The role focuses on hands-on learning, code quality, responsive design, and site performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Theme & Page Builder Work:** Build and customize WordPress themes, templates, and layouts using tools like Elementor, Gutenberg, or Divi.
* **Front-End & Back-End Support:** Write and adjust HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and basic PHP to add features and fix layout issues.
* **Plugins & E-Commerce:** Install, configure, and assist with custom plugins, WooCommerce stores, or third-party integrations.
* **Testing & Maintenance:** Debug errors, check cross-browser and mobile responsiveness, update content/plugins, and improve page load speed.
* **Collaboration & Documentation:** Work with designers, developers, and marketers, and document changes or tasks clearly.

**Required & Preferred Skills**

* **Core Web Technologies:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and basic PHP or MySQL.
* **WordPress Basics:** Understanding of WordPress themes, plugins, site structure, and on-page SEO basics.

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement

Application Question(s):

* Are you located in Tamil Nadu?
* Will you be able relocate?
* Have you completed any course or internships related to WordPress?
* What is your current salary?
* What is your expected salary?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* WordPress: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Junior Full Stak Developer -AI & ERP Intergration
description:
**Department:** IT / Digital Transformation  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years (Freshers with good technical knowledge can also apply)  
**Location:** Erode, Tamil Nadu  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a Junior Full Stack Developer to develop and maintain web applications, integrate ERP systems and implement AI-based solutions to automate business operations and improve organizational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain web applications and internal business tools.
* Work on frontend, backend and database development.
* Integrate ERP systems with other business applications through APIs.
* Develop dashboards for HR, Production, Inventory and Management.
* Implement AI-powered applications, chatbots and workflow automation.
* Automate manual business processes and reporting activities.
* Provide technical support and maintain existing applications.

Required Technical Skills

* HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React.js.
* Python / Node.js.
* MySQL / PostgreSQL.
* REST API development and integration.
* Basic knowledge of AI, LLMs and OpenAI APIs.
* Understanding of ERP systems.
* Git / GitHub knowledge.

Qualification

B.E. / B.Tech (IT / CSE), BCA, MCA or equivalent qualification.

Preferred Skills

* Knowledge of Odoo / SAP or other ERP platforms.
* Experience with AI tools and workflow automation (n8n / Make).
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently and learn new technologies.

Salary

As per experience and technical skills.

**Candidates are requested to share their updated resume along with project details and GitHub/portfolio links.**

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
